data.one_liner: Write ergonomic copyWith methods for immutable models without build_runner.
data.what_it_does: Provides a mixin and extension methods to distinguish between keeping a nullable field unchanged and explicitly setting it to null in copyWith methods. Operates entirely in pure Dart without code generation.
use_when: You want manual copyWith methods without dealing with build_runner or code generation.
You need a clean way to differentiate between omitting a nullable field and setting it to null.
avoid_when: You prefer automated code generation for your immutable models like freezed or built_value.
Your codebase has a massive number of models and manual boilerplate is strictly prohibited.
strengths: No code generation or build_runner setup required.
Solves the nullability dilemma in copyWith methods cleanly.
weaknesses: Fields must still be manually listed and implemented in copyWith.
Requires wrapping nullable field arguments with .maybe().

alternatives.name: freezed
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want fully automated code generation for immutable classes and copyWith methods instead of writing them manually.

alternatives.name: built_value
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer a strict, builder-based approach to immutability and code generation.
